features.name: User authentication
features.description: Users can sign up with an email and password, then log in to receive an access token.

features.name: Note creation
features.description: A logged-in user can create a new note with a title and content.

features.name: Note listing
features.description: A logged-in user can view a list of all their notes.

features.name: Note updating
features.description: A logged-in user can edit an existing note's title and content.

features.name: Note deletion
features.description: A logged-in user can delete an existing note.

constraints: No paid third-party APIs may be used.
Passwords must be stored hashed, never in plain text.
acceptance_criteria: A new user can sign up and then log in with the same credentials.
A logged-in user can create a new note and see it appear in their list of notes.
A logged-in user can view a list of all their notes.
A logged-in user can edit an existing note and see the changes reflected in their list of notes.
A logged-in user can delete an existing note and no longer see it in their list of notes.
